Refitting

Removing

- Check that the hydraulic actuator is not damaged.

Remove the plugs from the connectors and clean the actual connectors; check that the seals are efficient.

If a new hydraulic actuator is being fitted, remember it comes full of oil.

- Connect the pipes to the actuator, then fit the plates and secure them using the bolts.

- Connect the sensors to the actuator in the correct position, then secure them using the retainers; attach the tabs.

- Fit the wiring and pipe retaining bands.

When fitting the bands, position the wiring and the pipes as close as possible to one another to prevent interference with moving parts.

- Position the hydraulic actuator.

- Position the hydraulic actuator retaining bracket and tighten the bolts.

- Fasten the end of the hydraulic actuator using the pin, then fit the retaining clip in place.

- Restore the hydraulic system pressure.
